# cassandra_grant (Resource)

Grants a privilege on a resource to a Cassandra role. All arguments force a new grant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read access to every table in a keyspace.
resource "cassandra_grant" "read_app" {
  privilege     = "select"
  resource_type = "keyspace"
  keyspace_name = cassandra_keyspace.simple.name
  grantee       = cassandra_role.app.name
}

# Write access to a single table.
resource "cassandra_grant" "write_events" {
  privilege     = "modify"
  resource_type = "table"
  keyspace_name = cassandra_keyspace.simple.name
  table_name    = "events"
  grantee       = cassandra_role.app.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grantee` (String) Name of the role the privilege is granted to.
- `privilege` (String) Privilege to grant: `all`, `select`, `create`, `alter`, `drop`, `modify`, `authorize`, `describe`, `execute`.
- `resource_type` (String) Type of resource the privilege applies to: `all functions`, `all functions in keyspace`, `function`, `all keyspaces`, `keyspace`, `table`, `all roles`, `role`, `roles`, `mbean`, `mbeans`, `all mbeans`.

### Optional

- `function_name` (String) Name of the function. Required when `resource_type` is `function`.
- `keyspace_name` (String) Keyspace of the resource. Required when `resource_type` is `all functions in keyspace`, `function`, `keyspace`, `table`.
- `mbean_name` (String) Name of the MBean. Required when `resource_type` is `mbean`.
- `mbean_pattern` (String) Pattern selecting MBeans. Required when `resource_type` is `mbeans`.
- `role_name` (String) Name of the role. Required when `resource_type` is `role`.
- `table_name` (String) Name of the table. Required when `resource_type` is `table`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Hash identifying the grant.
